BOJ_URL.description: Base URL for the BoJ REST API backend.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for GitHub API operations (required for boj_github_* tools).

GITLAB_TOKEN.description: Private Token for GitLab API operations (required for boj_gitlab_* tools).

GITLAB_URL.description: Base URL for the GitLab instance.

BOJ_RATE_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of tool calls permitted per minute.

BOJ_LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging verbosity (debug, info, warn, error, silent).

BOJ_PROTOCOL.description: Primary protocol for cartridge communication (rest, grpc, graphql).

COORD_BACKEND_URL.description: URL for the local coordination bus backend.

COORD_REQUIRE_NICKEL.description: Set to '1' to enable strict Nickel-contract validation on coord_send_gated envelopes. Default off (envelopes validated permissively).

BOJ_TOOL_SCOPE.description: Advertised tool-surface scope. 'full' (or unset) advertises every tool (default, backward-compatible). 'core' advertises only the discovery/dispatch core (boj_health, boj_menu, boj_cartridges, boj_cartridge_info, boj_cartridge_invoke) plus all coord_* tools. A CSV of domain prefixes (e.g. 'core,github,browser') advertises core plus the named explicit groups. Every explicit boj_<domain>_* tool remains reachable via boj_cartridge_invoke regardless of scope.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: OTLP/HTTP collector endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:4318). When set, every tools/call emits an OTLP/JSON span to <endpoint>/v1/traces. Pairs with observe-mcp / grafana-mcp / prometheus-mcp for unified telemetry.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: Service name attribute on emitted spans.

OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION.description: Service version attribute on emitted spans.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.description: Optional comma-separated key=value headers attached to OTLP export POSTs (e.g. 'authorization=Bearer xyz,x-honeycomb-team=abc'). Used for hosted collectors that require auth.

BOJ_TRANSPORT.description: MCP transport selection (ADR-0013). 'stdio' (default) reads JSON-RPC from stdin and writes to stdout — the protocol clients like Claude Code launch the bridge as a subprocess over. 'http' starts an HTTP+SSE listener on BOJ_HTTP_PORT for remote / Workers / browser deployments. 'both' runs both simultaneously.

BOJ_HTTP_PORT.description: TCP port for the HTTP transport (used only when BOJ_TRANSPORT=http or BOJ_TRANSPORT=both).

BOJ_HTTP_BIND.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 (loopback only). Set to 0.0.0.0 for remote access — BOJ_HTTP_AUTH=none is refused on non-loopback binds.

BOJ_HTTP_AUTH.description: Authentication mode for the HTTP transport. 'none' is permitted only on loopback (refused otherwise). 'bearer' requires Authorization: Bearer <token> against the BOJ_HTTP_AUTH_TOKENS list. 'mtls' and 'oidc' are owed in PR2 of ADR-0013 — not yet implemented.

BOJ_HTTP_AUTH_TOKENS.description: Comma-separated list of accepted bearer tokens when BOJ_HTTP_AUTH=bearer. Whitespace around each token is trimmed; empty entries dropped. Required when BOJ_HTTP_AUTH=bearer.
